analogy.rationale: MAO inhibitors block monoamine degradation, and these cells express little MAOA/MAOB, so the transcriptional response should be weak; the closest analogs are other classes that modulate monoamine tone (COMT inhibition, monoamine reuptake/transport inhibition), which share downstream monoamine signaling but also produce limited transcriptional changes in these cell lines.
